Product model sources

The current product previews use the archives supplied for this project. Their source licences and authorship are not changed by conversion.

  • Classic tee — t-shirt-3d-model-free.zip
  • Fitted tee — t-shirt-for-female.zip
  • Pullover hoodie — hoodie.zip; hoodie (1).zip is an identical copy
  • Alternate hoodie — hoodie-black.zip
  • Sweater — sweater-pack.zip
  • Quarter-zip jumper — user-supplied ed6e5a1b-a18b-4b47-8c2d-856c077ec73b.obj. One complete garment was isolated from the pair. Source folds and proportions are retained; a separate web copy is simplified. No photographic textures are included.
  • Everyday sling bag — sling-bag (1).zip
  • Leather sling bag — leather-sun-wing-sling-bag.zip
  • Ceramic mug — pac-man-ceramic-coffee-mug-paladone.zip
  • Baseball cap — baseball-cap.zip
  • Fridge magnet — fridge-magnet-kayu-motif-ketam.zip

Preview preparation

Original textures, normal maps, vertex colours, decorative materials and image references were removed. Meshes use a neutral material and are centred and scaled for preview. Some dense meshes were simplified for the browser. Garment folds are retained. The original neutral mug geometry is retained; the supplied sling bags retain their original geometry and use neutral materials. The magnet's crab and lettering were removed and replaced with a blank metal face and clear epoxy dome. Product thumbnails are rendered from these prepared assets.

Client artwork is added separately in the studio. Preview dimensions are guides, not manufacturing templates.

Model delivery

Web delivery uses lossless Meshopt encoding without further geometry simplification or quantization. Exact vertex attributes and equivalent triangle topology are verified after decoding. Original neutral GLBs remain available as a compatibility fallback. Meshoptimizer by Arseny Kapoulkine, MIT licence.

Interface libraries

SVG interface icons: Lucide Icons and Contributors, ISC licence. Three.js authors, MIT licence.
